title: Instagram Generator Enhancement
description: Fix logo compositing, prompt templates, copy prompt constants, logo injection, dan tambah field per kategori dengan live sync ke prompt
completion_notes: Phase 1: Fixed logo compositing (makeLogoOverlay in compose-engine), all prompt templates rewritten with WEARPACK/BRAND_COLORS/SAFE_ZONE helpers, copy prompt constants fixed in Bahasa Indonesia, route cleaned up (removed unreliable CP_LOGO_URL base64 injection). Phase 2: Added per-category fields with live prompt sync — Edukasi (topik, poin utama, foto referensi), Pencapaian (nama, angka/statistik, deskripsi, foto), Event (nama, lokasi/tanggal, deskripsi, foto), Promosi Produk (nama produk, keunggulan, CTA, foto produk), Hari Nasional (pesan khusus), Ucapan HUT (nama, usia, logo customer, ucapan). All fields sync live to prompt textarea via unified useEffect.
